tasks.title: Harden browser observation freshness and recovery
tasks.objective: Make the native Chromium observation heartbeat remain fresh across service-worker restarts, browser refreshes, and transient bridge failures without weakening the existing watchdog boundary.
acceptance_criteria: A stale or missing observation is detected without treating a stale heartbeat as healthy.
Native controller recovery restores a fresh observation without requiring Tampermonkey.
Recovery does not create duplicate operations or bypass authentication boundaries.
Recovery remains bounded and surfaces the exact failure stage instead of silently waiting.
verification: Run the targeted browser/controller recovery tests.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Harden browser terminality, silent-stall detection, and single-send boundaries
tasks.objective: Prevent a ChatGPT operation from appearing to work while never reaching a verifiable terminal state, and prevent delayed acknowledgements from causing duplicate submissions.
acceptance_criteria: A submission is recorded as fired exactly once and no fallback send strategy is invoked after a send mechanism has fired.
A generation that stops producing meaningful terminal evidence is distinguished from a healthy long-running generation and exits through a bounded recovery path.
Terminal completion requires verifiable assistant-response evidence rather than UI timing alone.
Provider, browser, and model-contract failures are classified early enough to avoid unnecessary long retries.
verification: Run the native submission, response-recovery, and failure-classification tests.
Run a focused live browser smoke exercise covering a successful response and a silent-stall/recovery case.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Make M0/M1/M2 live acceptance gates fail fast and diagnostically
tasks.objective: Turn live acceptance from a long opaque wait into bounded evidence-producing gates that identify the exact seam that failed before expensive retries begin.
acceptance_criteria: M0 records distinct submission, terminal-response, parser, patch-application, validation, and commit stages.
M0/M1/M2 stop or retry according to the detected failure class instead of treating every stall as generic chat failure.
Live artifacts remain internally consistent and are not synthesized from source inspection or unit tests.
A failed live gate preserves enough evidence to resume the same milestone without restarting unrelated work.
verification: Run the M0 live harness through successful completion.
Run the M1 harness and verify its 20-operation evidence contract.
Run targeted acceptance-harness tests and the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Support multi-prompt task completion as a first-class execution pattern
tasks.objective: Allow a real engineering task to span multiple prompt operations when needed while preserving one durable task identity, bounded retries, and exact operation provenance.
acceptance_criteria: A task may require multiple prompt operations without being treated as duplicate task work.
Each prompt operation has a durable operation ID and an unambiguous relationship to the parent task attempt.
A retry never re-submits an operation whose submission was already acknowledged unless explicit recovery proves the original operation is lost or terminal.
Task completion summarizes the complete sequence of verified operations and repository changes.
verification: Run controller, bridge, task-ledger, and retry/recovery tests.
Run a focused live multi-operation exercise after M0/M1 acceptance is green.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Tune unattended pacing and retry behavior from measured failure evidence
tasks.objective: Reduce wasted wall-clock time by distinguishing healthy long generations, silent browser stalls, contract-invalid responses, verification failures, and infrastructure failures before selecting the next retry action.
acceptance_criteria: Retry policy is explicitly different for browser/controller infrastructure, malformed completion contracts, patch/verification failures, and legitimate multi-prompt continuation.
The same failure signature does not consume unbounded retry cycles without a recovery action or terminal stop reason.
Long-running generations are not reloaded solely because they are old when meaningful progress is still observed.
Measured latency and failure evidence is persisted so later pacing changes can be based on runtime data rather than guesswork.
verification: Run retry, watchdog, telemetry, and failure-classification tests.
Review M0/M1 live timing and failure evidence before finalizing thresholds.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Make completion evidence authoritative
tasks.objective: Ensure unattended task completion is based on reproducible repository verification and durable ledger evidence rather than model claims alone.
acceptance_criteria: A model cannot mark an unverified patch complete.
Verification failures retain the current task for repair.
Completed-task records include concrete verification evidence and remain recoverable after restart.
verification: Run the overnight engine and task-ledger tests.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Maintain deterministic-first hybrid roadmap planning
tasks.objective: Select the next executable task from a structured roadmap using deterministic dependency and safety rules first, with optional AI ranking only among eligible tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmaps have stable task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, verification, scope, and finite status values.
Dependency cycles, missing dependencies, invalid AI rankings, and scope escapes are rejected deterministically.
The executor receives only one selected task and never receives authority to choose the next task.
Task sizes and dependency boundaries keep the first unattended tasks small enough to verify quickly before larger work is scheduled.
verification: Run the hybrid planner unit tests.
Run the overnight engine scheduler tests.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Harden provider-neutral planning and execution boundaries
tasks.objective: Keep provider-specific adapters behind explicit capability boundaries so planner and executor behavior remains provider-neutral and authorization rules remain controller-owned.
acceptance_criteria: Planner inputs and outputs are provider-neutral.
Fallback providers cannot apply repository changes directly.
Provider failures remain recoverable without transferring control-plane authority to a model.
verification: Run provider router and security boundary tests.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Strengthen application and website verification
tasks.objective: Extend verification so application behavior, integration failures, accessibility basics, and obvious functional regressions are tested rather than inferred from model output.
acceptance_criteria: Verification checks target observable application behavior instead of narrative claims.
Failures produce actionable evidence for the current task retry cycle.
The added checks remain bounded and deterministic for unattended operation.
verification: Run the application/web smoke tests and their targeted regressions.
Run the canonical repository validation.

tasks.title: Run sustained unattended burn-in and tune throughput from evidence
tasks.objective: Validate that the hardened control plane can sustain long sequences of real work without silent stalls, duplicate submissions, stuck retries, or loss of repository provenance, then tune throughput using the measured runtime profile.
acceptance_criteria: A sustained live run completes a representative sequence of independent tasks with no duplicate browser submissions.
Silent stalls have bounded detection and recovery time and do not consume an entire unattended work window unnoticed.
Task throughput, recovery frequency, retry frequency, and verification latency are captured as runtime evidence.
Throughput improvements are introduced only after the corresponding reliability evidence is stable.
verification: Run the sustained live burn-in harness using the authenticated native Chromium controller.
Review runtime telemetry for stall and retry patterns.
Run the canonical repository validation before and after throughput tuning.

schedule_notes.basis: Speculative planning based on current debugging pace, with shorter later windows as browser automation reliability reduces manual waiting and failed retry cycles.
schedule_notes.acceleration_assumption: Later estimates assume bounded recovery, fast failure classification, multi-prompt task continuity, and stable duplicate-send protection are functioning sufficiently to reduce idle time.
